```{r data-generation, echo=FALSE, results="hide"}
library(exams)
n <- 18
p <- 0.25
x <- 2
correct <- pbinom(x + 2, n, p) - pbinom(x - 1, n, p)
answers <- sprintf("%.4f", c(correct, pbinom(x + 2, n, p),
  pbinom(x + 1, n, p) - pbinom(x - 1, n, p), dbinom(x, n, p)))
solutions <- c(TRUE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE)
ord <- sample(seq_along(answers))
answers <- answers[ord]
solutions <- solutions[ord]
```

Question
========

In a laboratory experiment, `r n` animals receive a test drug. Each animal has probability `r sprintf("%.2f", p)` of dying, independently of the others. What is the probability that between `r x` and `r x + 2` animals die, inclusive?

Choose the answer rounded to four decimal places.

```{r question-list, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
answerlist(answers, markup = "markdown")
```

Solution
========

Let $X$ denote the number of animals that die. Then $X \sim \operatorname{Bin}(`r n`, `r sprintf("%.2f", p)`)$. Hence
$P(`r x`\le X\le `r x + 2`)=P(X\le `r x + 2`)-P(X\le `r x - 1`)=`r sprintf("%.4f", correct)`$.

Meta-information
================

exsolution: `r mchoice2string(solutions)`
